title: Vendored Claude Code skills manifest
description: Declares which Claude Code skills are vendored into .claude/skills/ from upstream git repositories.

name.description: Destination folder under .claude/skills/. Should match the skill's own SKILL.md `name`.

subpath.description: Path inside the upstream repo that contains the skill's SKILL.md.

ref.description: Branch or tag to vendor from (e.g. "main" or "1.2.0").
